full_name: Kelly Luce | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2016–2017 Fiction & Poetry Evelyn Green Davis Fellow Independent Writer
bio: Kelly Luce is a fiction writer. She is the author of the collection Three Scenarios in Which Hana Sasaki Grows a Tail: Stories (A Strange Object, 2013) and of Pull Me Under: A Novel (Farrar, Straus and Giroux, 2016).
